data.desc: Acorn's wholly owned OmniMetrix subsidiary is a pioneer and leader in wireless remote monitoring and control solutions for critical infrastructure assets including standby generators, cell tower campuses, gas pipelines, data centers and energy sites. OmniMetrix serves tens of thousands of commercial and residential endpoints, including approximately 50 Fortune/Global 500 companies, across telecom, manufacturing, healthcare, data centers, retail, public transportation, energy distribution and government, as well as residential customers through generator dealers. OmniMetrix's industry-leading, cost-effective solutions make critical systems more reliable, provide security, and also enable automated 'demand response' electric grid support via enrolled backup generators.
